long_biography.plain_text:
Raised in New York's Spanish Harlem by Puerto Rican parents, Marco Antonio Muñiz began by writing songs and singing backing vocals before adopting the name Marc Anthony. A shift from dance-pop towards salsa brought his first Spanish-language album, followed by a parallel English-language recording career and sustained international touring.

Anthony's work later expanded beyond his own performances. He co-founded Magnus with talent agent Michel Vega, building an entertainment group active in artist management, booking, recording and digital production. His screen work includes playing salsa singer Héctor Lavoe in El Cantante, while his recordings have continued to earn major industry recognition.
long_biography.html:
Raised in New York's Spanish Harlem by Puerto Rican parents, Marco Antonio Muñiz began by writing songs and singing backing vocals before adopting the name Marc Anthony. A shift from dance-pop towards salsa brought his first Spanish-language album, followed by a parallel English-language recording career and sustained international touring.

Anthony's work later expanded beyond his own performances. He co-founded Magnus with talent agent Michel Vega, building an entertainment group active in artist management, booking, recording and digital production. His screen work includes playing salsa singer Héctor Lavoe in El Cantante, while his recordings have continued to earn major industry recognition.
